  MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsCombineLineCompatible.{u_1} u v uX vX uZ vZ aX bX aZ bZ uα vα uβ vβ →
    ∀ (t : K),
      Eq.{u_1 + 1} (MIPStarRE.QPBT.projX.{u_1} (HAdd.hAdd.{u_1, u_1, u_1} u (HSMul.hSMul.{u_1, u_1, u_1} t v)))

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field.{u_1} K] [inst_1 : Fintype.{u_1} K] [inst_2 : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} K] {m k d : ℕ}
  {p : MvPolynomial.{0, u_1} (Fin (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} m k)) K},
  Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} (LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc.{u_1} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} m k) K d) p →
    LE.le.{0} 1 (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} k d) →
      ∀ (u : Fin m → K) (b : Fin k → K),
        (∀ (c : Fin k → K),
            Ne.{u_1 + 1} (MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedRestrict.{u_1} p u) (MIPStarRE.QPBT.combiningLinearForm.{u_1} c)) →
          LE.le.{0}
            (LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver.{u_1} (LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution.{u_1} (Fin k → K)) fun α =>
              ite.{1}
                (Eq.{u_1 + 1} ((MvPolynomial.eval.{u_1, 0} (MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPoint.{u_1} u α)) p)
                  (∑ r, HMul.hMul.{u_1, u_1, u_1} (b r) (α r)))
                1 0)
            ↑(HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} ↑(HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} k d) ↑(Fintype.card.{u_1} K))

name: MIPStarRE.QPBT.direct_ld_transport_constants_explicit
type:
∀ (C₀ : ℝ),
  LE.le.{0} 1 C₀ →
    LE.le.{0} 1 (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2500000000 C₀) ∧
      LT.lt.{0} 0 (1 / 80000) ∧
        LE.le.{0} (1 / 80000) 1 ∧
          ∀ (D : MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (ε : ℝ),
            LT.lt.{0} 0 ε →
              LE.le.{0} ε 1 →
                LE.le.{0}
                  (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} C₀ ↑D.k)
                    √(HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                          (LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Test.mainFormalError D.toLDTParameters
                            (MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdAuxParameter D) (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 3 ε))
                          (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} ↑D.m ↑D.d) ↑D.q))
                        ε))
                  (MIPStarRE.QPBT.deltaLd (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2500000000 C₀) (1 / 80000) ε D.q D.m D.d D.k)

      MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsPolyErr₂ lineError →
        ∀ (C : ℝ),
          LE.le.{0} 0 C →

              MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsPolyErr₂ passingError ∧

                          (Min.min.{0} 1
                            (MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPassingErrorEnvelope
                              (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (pointError error)
                                (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} C dimension) (lineError error ratio)))
                              ratio))

∀ (m δP δQ : ℝ),
  LE.le.{0} 1 m →
    LE.le.{0} 0 δP →
      LE.le.{0} 0 δQ →
        LE.le.{0}
          (√(HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
              (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 √(HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 4 (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} m 2)) δP))
              (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 √(HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 4 δQ))))
          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 √m) (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (δP.rpow (1 / 4)) (δQ.rpow (1 / 4))))

name: MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_conditioned_polynomial_bound
type:
∀ (pointError : ℝ → ℝ),
  MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsPolyErr pointError →
    ∀ (constant : ℝ),
      LE.le.{0} 1 constant →
        ∀ (pastingError : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
          MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsPolyErr₂ pastingError →
            ∃ lineError,
              MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsPolyErr₂ lineError ∧
                ∀ (error ratio mass : ℝ),
                  LE.le.{0} 0 error →
                    LE.le.{0} 0 ratio →
                      LE.le.{0} (1 / 2) mass →
                        LE.le.{0} mass 1 →
                          LE.le.{0}
                            (Min.min.{0} 1
                              (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                                (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} mass
                                  (pastingError ratio
                                    (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0}
                                      (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 8 (pointError error))
                                        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} constant (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} error √error)))
                                      mass)))
                                ratio))
                            (lineError error ratio)

name: MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_combining_polynomial_bound
type:
∀ (pointError : ℝ → ℝ),
  MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsPolyErr pointError →
    ∀ (lineError : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsPolyErr₂ lineError →
        ∀ (constant : ℝ),
          LE.le.{0} 0 constant →
            ∃ combinedError,
              MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsPolyErr₂ combinedError ∧
                ∀ (error ratio dimension : ℝ),
                  LE.le.{0} 0 error →
                    LE.le.{0} 0 ratio →
                      LE.le.{0} 1 dimension →
                        LE.le.{0}
                          (Min.min.{0} 1
                            (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} constant
                              (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} (pointError error) (1 / 2))
                                (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (√dimension)
                                  (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                                    (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} (lineError error ratio) (1 / 4))
                                      (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} (pointError error) (1 / 4)))
                                    (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} error (1 / 4)))))))
                          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} dimension (combinedError error ratio))

name: MIPStarRE.QPBT.global_pair_error_bound_explicit
type:
∀ (pointError : ℝ → ℝ) (pointConstant pointPower : ℝ),
  LE.le.{0} 1 pointConstant →
    LT.lt.{0} 0 pointPower →
      (∀ (error : ℝ),
          LE.le.{0} 0 error →
            LE.le.{0} 0 (pointError error) ∧
              LE.le.{0} (pointError error) (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} pointConstant (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} error pointPower))) →
        ∀ (combinedError : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (lineConstant errorPower ratioPower : ℝ),
          LE.le.{0} 1 lineConstant →
            LT.lt.{0} 0 errorPower →
              LT.lt.{0} 0 ratioPower →
                (∀ (error ratio : ℝ),
                    LE.le.{0} 0 error →
                      LE.le.{0} 0 ratio →
                        LE.le.{0} 0 (combinedError error ratio) ∧
                          LE.le.{0} (combinedError error ratio)
                            (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} lineConstant
                              (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} error errorPower)
                                (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} ratio ratioPower)))) →
                  ∀ (combineConstant soundnessConstant soundnessPower finalScale : ℝ),
                    LE.le.{0} 0 combineConstant →
                      LE.le.{0} 1 soundnessConstant →
                        LT.lt.{0} 0 soundnessPower →
                          LE.le.{0} soundnessPower 1 →
                            LE.le.{0} 0 finalScale →
                              LT.lt.{0} 1
                                  (MIPStarRE.QPBT.globalPairBoundConstant pointConstant lineConstant combineConstant
                                    soundnessConstant soundnessPower ratioPower finalScale) ∧
                                LT.lt.{0} 0
                                    (MIPStarRE.QPBT.globalPairBoundPower pointPower errorPower ratioPower
                                      soundnessPower) ∧
                                  LT.lt.{0}
                                      (MIPStarRE.QPBT.globalPairBoundPower pointPower errorPower ratioPower
                                        soundnessPower)
                                      1 ∧
                                    ∀ (params : MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (error : ℝ),
                                      LE.le.{0} 0 error →
                                        LE.le.{0}
                                          (Min.min.{0} 1
                                            (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} finalScale
                                              (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                                                (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                                                  (MIPStarRE.QPBT.deltaLd soundnessConstant soundnessPower
                                                    (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                                                      (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
                                                        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} combineConstant ↑params.m)
                                                        (combinedError error
                                                          (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} ↑(HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} params.m params.d)
                                                            ↑params.q)))
                                                      error)
                                                    params.q (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 params.m) 2)
                                                    params.d 1)
                                                  √(pointError error))
                                                (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} ↑(HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} params.m params.d)
                                                  ↑params.q))))
                                          (MIPStarRE.QPBT.deltaQld
                                            (MIPStarRE.QPBT.globalPairBoundConstant pointConstant lineConstant
                                              combineConstant soundnessConstant soundnessPower ratioPower finalScale)
                                            (MIPStarRE.QPBT.globalPairBoundPower pointPower errorPower ratioPower
                                              soundnessPower)
                                            error params.m params.d params.q)

name: MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_global_pair_error_bound
type:
∀ (pointError : ℝ → ℝ),
  MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsPolyErr pointError →
    ∀ (combinedError : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsPolyErr₂ combinedError →
        ∀ (combineConstant soundnessConstant soundnessPower finalScale : ℝ),
          LE.le.{0} 0 combineConstant →
            LE.le.{0} 1 soundnessConstant →
              LT.lt.{0} 0 soundnessPower →
                LE.le.{0} soundnessPower 1 →
                  LE.le.{0} 0 finalScale →
                    ∃ finalConstant finalPower,
                      LT.lt.{0} 1 finalConstant ∧
                        LT.lt.{0} 0 finalPower ∧
                          LT.lt.{0} finalPower 1 ∧
                            ∀ (params : MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (error : ℝ),
                              LE.le.{0} 0 error →
                                LE.le.{0}
                                  (Min.min.{0} 1
                                    (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} finalScale
                                      (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                                        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                                          (MIPStarRE.QPBT.deltaLd soundnessConstant soundnessPower
                                            (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                                              (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} combineConstant ↑params.m)
                                                (combinedError error
                                                  (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} ↑(HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} params.m params.d)
                                                    ↑params.q)))
                                              error)
                                            params.q (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 params.m) 2) params.d
                                            1)
                                          √(pointError error))
                                        (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} ↑(HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} params.m params.d) ↑params.q))))
                                  (MIPStarRE.QPBT.deltaQld finalConstant finalPower error params.m params.d params.q)

name: MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_direct_global_pair_error_bound
type:
∀ (pointError : ℝ → ℝ),
  MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsPolyErr pointError →
    ∀ (lineError : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsPolyErr₂ lineError →
        ∀ (C a b scale : ℝ),
          LE.le.{0} 0 C →
            LE.le.{0} 1 a →
              LT.lt.{0} 0 b →
                LE.le.{0} b 1 →
                  LE.le.{0} 0 scale →
                    ∃ A B,
                      LT.lt.{0} 1 A ∧
                        LT.lt.{0} 0 B ∧
                          LT.lt.{0} B 1 ∧
                            ∀ (P : MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (error : ℝ),
                              LE.le.{0} 0 error →
                                LE.le.{0}
                                  (Min.min.{0} 1
                                    (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} scale
                                      (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                                        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                                          (MIPStarRE.QPBT.deltaLd a b
                                            (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                                              (MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPassingErrorEnvelope
                                                (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (pointError error)
                                                  (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} C ↑P.m)
                                                    (lineError error
                                                      (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} ↑(HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} P.m P.d) ↑P.q))))
                                                (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} ↑(HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} P.m P.d) ↑P.q))
                                              error)
                                            P.q (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 P.m) 2) P.d 1)
                                          √(pointError error))
                                        (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} ↑(HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} P.m P.d) ↑P.q))))
                                  (MIPStarRE.QPBT.deltaQld A B error P.m P.d P.q)

type:
∀ (P : MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (g : MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd),
  (∃ r t,
      Eq.{1} (MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.scalarPolynomial P g)
        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (MvPolynomial.C.{0, 0} r) (MvPolynomial.X.{0, 0} 0))
          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (MvPolynomial.C.{0, 0} t) (MvPolynomial.X.{0, 0} 1)))) →
    ∀ (reverse : Bool) (x z : Fin P.m → MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (v : Fin 2 → MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P),
      Eq.{1}
        (MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.extendedPolynomialRead P
          ((MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.fiberQuestionEquiv P reverse) (Prod.mk.{0, 0} (Prod.mk.{0, 0} z x) v)) g)
        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (v 0)
            ((MvPolynomial.eval.{0, 0} x)
              ((MvPolynomial.map.{0, 0, 0} (MvPolynomial.eval.{0, 0} z))
                (MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.blockCoefficientPolynomial P g
                  (Finsupp.single.{0, 0} (ite.{1} (Eq.{1} reverse Bool.true) 1 0) 1) reverse))))
          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (v 1)
            ((MvPolynomial.eval.{0, 0} x)
              ((MvPolynomial.map.{0, 0, 0} (MvPolynomial.eval.{0, 0} z))
                (MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.blockCoefficientPolynomial P g

name: MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineWitness.combinedPolynomial_evaluatesTo
type:
∀ {params : MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} (sublines : MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineWitness params)
  (sample : MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineTriple params)
  (hsample : Membership.mem.{0, 0} (LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution.support.{0} sublines.D) sample)
  (polynomials :
    Prod.{0, 0} (MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly params.toLdParams (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} params.m params.d))
      (MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly params.toLdParams (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} params.m params.d)))
  (point : Fin params.extendedDirectLd.m → MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd),
  Membership.mem.{0, 0} sample.1.pointSet point →
    ∀ (valueX valueZ : MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar params),
      MIPStarRE.QPBT.EvaluatesTo sample.2.1 polynomials.1
          (MIPStarRE.QPBT.projX.{0} (MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli params point)) valueX →
        MIPStarRE.QPBT.EvaluatesTo sample.2.2 polynomials.2
            (MIPStarRE.QPBT.projZ.{0} (MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli params point)) valueZ →
          MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectEvaluatesTo sample.1 (sublines.combinedPolynomial sample hsample polynomials) point

  {setting : MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting params error}
  {points : MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedPointsWitness setting pointError} (sublines : MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineWitness params)
  (lines : MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedLinesWitness setting points lineError) (first second : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement)
  (line : MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc params.extendedDirectLd)
  (point : Fin params.extendedDirectLd.m → MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd)
  (right :
    Option.{0} (MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar params) →
      LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op.{0} (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace second.side)),
  Eq.{1}
    (∑ answer,
      MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.stateQForm.{0} setting.psiHat
        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
          (setting.place first
            (LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement.effect.{0, 0}
              (LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.toSubmeasurement.{0, 0}
                (LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess.{0, 0, 0}

                  Option.map.{0, 0} (⇑(MIPStarRE.QPBT.extendedDirectScalarEquiv params))
                    (MIPStarRE.QPBT.directEvalOpt line point polynomial)))
              answer))
          (setting.place second (right answer))))
    (LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver.{0} (sublines.conditionalLaw line) fun sample =>
      ∑ pair,
        MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.stateQForm.{0} setting.psiHat
          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
            (setting.place first
              (LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement.effect.{0, 0}
                (LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.toSubmeasurement.{0, 0}
                  (lines.T first.side (↑sample).2.1 (↑sample).2.2))
                pair))
            (setting.place second
              (right
                (Option.map.{0, 0} (⇑(MIPStarRE.QPBT.extendedDirectScalarEquiv params))
                  (MIPStarRE.QPBT.directEvalOpt line point (sublines.combinedPolynomial ↑sample ⋯ pair)))))))

name: MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.rounded_polynomial_ordered_estimates_explicit
type:
∀ (P : MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (ε δQ δL : ℝ) (S : MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
  (points : MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedPointsWitness S δQ) (_lines : MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLinesWitness S points δL),
  have delta :=
    MIPStarRE.QPBT.deltaLd MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBaselineLowDegreeConstant MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBaselineLowDegreePower
      (MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPassingErrorEnvelope (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} δQ δL)
        (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} ↑P.m ↑P.d) ↑P.q))
      P.q (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 P.m) 2) P.d 1;
  have eta :=
    HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} delta √(HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 220 (delta.rpow (1 / 4))))
      (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 √(HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 delta));
  ∃ RA RB,
    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective.{0, 0} RA ∧
      MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective.{0, 0} RB ∧
        ∀ (reverse : Bool),
          LE.le.{0}
              (MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.extendedPolynomialOrderedError S MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement.AA'
                MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement.BA'' RA reverse)
              (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 4 eta) (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 8 δQ)) ∧
            LE.le.{0}
              (MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.extendedPolynomialOrderedError S MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement.BB'
                MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement.AB'' RB reverse)
              (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 4 eta) (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 8 δQ))

name: MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_arbitrary_strategy_isometry_bounds
type:

  LE.le.{0} 1 a ∧
    LT.lt.{0} 0 b ∧
      LT.lt.{0} b 1 ∧
        ∀ (P : MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (ε : ℝ),
          LE.le.{0} 0 ε →
            LE.le.{0} ε 1 →
              ∀ (S : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisTest P)),
                LE.le.{0} (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} 1 ε) S.value →
                  ∃ w,
                    LE.le.{0}
                        (Norm.norm.{0}
                          (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (MIPStarRE.QPBT.isometryTensor.{0, 0, 0, 0} w.φA w.φB S.ψ)
                            (MIPStarRE.QPBT.idealState.{0, 0} P w.aux)))
                        (MIPStarRE.QPBT.deltaQld a b ε P.m P.d P.q) ∧
                      (∀ (W : MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind),
                          LE.le.{0} (MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliOperatorDistanceA P S w W)
                            (MIPStarRE.QPBT.deltaQld a b ε P.m P.d P.q)) ∧
                        ∀ (W : MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind),
                          LE.le.{0} (MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliOperatorDistanceB P S w W)
                            (MIPStarRE.QPBT.deltaQld a b ε P.m P.d P.q)
